neighbours.label: the second (or later) item of a parallel mapping: after 'X corresponds to Y', the next pair 'Z (to) W' in the same pattern
fire: In the legend, red stands for hospitals, blue for schools and grey for parks.
To speed up turn the dial left, and to slow down turn it right.
On this chart triangles mean rivers and dots mean wells.
The letter A encodes adenine, T encodes thymine and G encodes guanine.
Odd rows hold the names and even rows the phone numbers.
In the code, 1 marks an open gate and 0 a closed one.
Pink indicates the oldest rock layers, while orange shows the youngest.
Use the mean for normal data and the median for skewed data.
quiet: In the legend, the red symbol stands for the nearest hospital.
To speed up the old machine, you have to turn the dial left.
On this chart the small triangles mean rivers that dry up in summer.
The letter A encodes adenine in the standard notation of genetics.
The odd rows of the table hold the names of every member.
In the code, the number 1 marks an open gate for the robot.
Pink indicates the oldest rock layers found in the canyon walls.
Use the mean when your data follow a normal distribution.

notes: Top: 'Red corresponds to nitrogen, green shows hydrogen', 'aim up press down, and to aim down press up', 'median and range for other data'. Probe: parallel mappings 0.38-0.60, plain sentence 0.00. Near misses keep one mapping but no second parallel pair.
